<!-- 
TIPS FOR EFFECTIVE RESEARCH SPIKES:
1. Always time-box research - don't fall into analysis paralysis
2. Focus on answering specific questions, not learning everything
3. Build small proof-of-concepts rather than reading forever
4. Document what you learned even if you don't reach a clear answer
5. Share findings with the team (spike review)
6. Create follow-up issues for the implementation work
-->
